couplets.en: For as long as tears stay close.
That is how long we'll sing.

lines: Tanha tanha dukh jhelenge, mehfil mehfil gayenge
couplets.en: We'll bear our sorrow alone and sing wherever people gather.

lines: Tum jo socho woh tum jaano, hum to apni kehte hain
couplets.en: Your thoughts are yours, and we'll say what is in our hearts.

lines: Der na karna ghar aane mein, warna ghar kho jayenge
couplets.en: Come home before too long, or we may lose the place we call home.

lines: Kin raahon se door hai manzil, kaun sa rasta mushkil hai
couplets.en: On which roads is the destination far, and which road is hardest?

lines: Hum bhi jab thak kar baithenge, auron ko samjhayenge
couplets.en: When we too sit down weary, we'll tell others what we've learned.

lines: Achchhi surat wale saare patthar dil hon, mumkin hai
couplets.en: Perhaps every lovely face hides a heart of stone.

lines: Hum to us din rai denge, jis din dhoka khayenge
couplets.en: We'll give our advice the day we've been deceived ourselves.

lines: Bachchon ke chhote haathon ko chaand sitare chhoone do
couplets.en: Let children's small hands touch the moon and stars.

lines: Chaar kitaben padh kar ye bhi hum jaise ho jayenge
couplets.en: A few books later, they'll be just like us.

lines: Jab tak aansu paas rahenge, tab tak geet sunayenge
couplets.en: As long as tears stay close, we'll have songs to sing.

lines: Tanha tanha dukh jhelenge, mehfil mehfil gayenge
couplets.en: We'll bear our sorrow alone and sing wherever people gather.
